name: Hollow Kingdom
tagline: Rebuild a kingdom one empty hall at a time.
description: Rebuild a kingdom one empty hall at a time. Gather by day, defend your walls by night, and light the windows of a castle the dark forgot. Every hall you restore brings back new villagers, new powers and a new voice to the music.
controls: Mouse/touch: tap halls, drag to pan, wheel/pinch to zoom. Space: speed/pause, 1-4: powers, H: halls, Esc: menu. Gamepad supported.
